questions.prompt: Who became the third person to win the World Cup as both a player (1998) and a manager (2018)?

questions.prompt: Which country has qualified for the most World Cups from Asia (11 times through 2022)?

questions.prompt: Which country was the only debutant nation at the 2022 FIFA World Cup?

questions.prompt: In which year did Wales return to the FIFA World Cup after a 64-year absence (since 1958)?
